entry.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and IBM Launch Open Secure AI Alliance to Strengthen AI Cybersecurity
entry.summary: More than 40 technology companies and organizations have allied to develop open-source AI security tools and standards for cyber defense.

entry.title: A Man Gave Border Agents His Phone Passcode. It Wiped Everything. Now He's Facing Federal Charges

entry.summary: The company says it now holds 5.79 million ETH, equal to 4.8% of the cryptocurrency's circulating supply, while expanding its staking operations and share buyback program.

entry.title: Strategy Adds $525M to Cash Reserve, Skips Bitcoin Buy for Fifth Week

entry.title: Crypto Firms Pivoting to AI Is 'Zero-Sum' Thinking: Coinbase CEO

entry.title: Samsung Wallet Will Add Stablecoin Support, Including USDC
entry.summary: Samsung showed a wallet mockup holding Circle's USDC at Galaxy Unpacked. But details are scarce.

entry.title: Poolin, Once One of Bitcoin's Biggest Mining Pools, Files for Bankruptcy

entry.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M to Scale Sam Altman’s ‘Proof of Human’ ID
